# TABLES {#sec-tables}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_setup.R")
```

Each table below is the `gt` object saved with the version's table PDF (`output/poppk/v`r poppk_version`/tables/`), checked against the hash in the provenance record, and printed unchanged: same rows, statistics, rounding, labels and footnotes as the QC'd PDF.

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in spec$outputs$tables) {
  name <- output_name(e)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", md_escape(e$description %||% name)))
  cat(sprintf("Source: `%s` (script `%s/%s.R`)\n\n", e$path, spec$script_dir, name))
  cat(as.character(print_table_display(table_display(name), label = paste0("tbl:", name))))
  cat("\n\n\\clearpage\n\n")
}
```
